articles.title: Foreign Secretary Misri wraps up US visit with talks on nuclear cooperation and LPG exports
articles.summary: India's Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri discussed strengthening energy cooperation with the US Energy Secretary. This strategic dialogue highlights India's proactive efforts to enhance energy security and diversify its sources through robust international partnerships, reinforcing the India-US bilateral relationship.
